cobros-reason-desc: Required. It is kept in the log.
cobros-total-split-help: If you enter a total, it is split by due date and the per-row amounts are ignored. If you collect less than a receipt, another pending receipt is left for the rest.
cobros-cancelled: %count% payment(s) cancelled; the receipts are pending again.
cobros-module-inactive: The Quick payments module is not active in your plan.
cobros-nothing-to-pay: There are no pending receipts to collect.
cobros-bad-date: The payment date is not valid.
cobros-future-date: The payment date cannot be in the future.
cobros-bad-account: The bank account does not exist.
cobros-amount-exceeds: The amount is not valid or exceeds what is pending on the receipt.
cobros-receipt-not-pending: A receipt is no longer pending. Nothing was collected.
cobros-cant-cancel: That payment cannot be cancelled: it is already cancelled or the receipt has changed since.
